title: A Custom date range needs valid dates and rejects a span over 366 days
preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded..
steps:
1. Open the date range selector and choose Custom.
2. Pick only a start date and observe - then pick an end date earlier than the start and observe.
3. Pick a valid start and end date (start on or before end, within 366 days).
4. Now try a custom span wider than 366 days (for example 400 days).
expected:
1. A date picker opens requiring both a start and an end date.
2. The report does not reload until both dates are valid; a start after the end is not accepted.
3. With both valid dates selected, the data reloads for that range.
4. A span wider than 366 days (counting both the start and end dates) is rejected - the selection is not applied.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S2-R3), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.

AUTOMATION: READY
